    seg_len = target_reach / num_segments

    bot_chord = []

    anchor_bot_y = structure_y - anchor_sep/2

        x = WALL_X + (i + 0.5) * seg_len

            sandbox.add_joint(top_chord[i-1], tb, (WALL_X + i * seg_len, ty), type='rigid')
